title: A New Electronic Festival Is Debuting in San Diego This Winter With Zeds Dead, Ninajirachi, Sara Landry & More
summary: Temper will happen at the city's Petco Park in December.
contentText:
A new electronic festival will rumble to life in San Diego this winter.

Temper is happening at the city’s Petco Park on Wednesday, December 30 with a pre-New Year’s Eve lineup featuring a motherlode load of bass artists including Zeds Dead, Crankdat, Whethan, G Jones, Mary Droppinz, Distinct Motive, Levity playing b2b with Richard Finger and hard techno titan Sara Landry.

Beyond that, the fest will also feature experimental electronic leader Ninajirachi, a DJ set from singer-songwriter Tiffany Day, sets from Starjunk 95, Bad Girl Bailey and many more. See the complete lineup below.

Temper will happen across three stages located on Petco Park’s field and in the surrounding area, with the show also promising, a press release notes, “thoughtfully curated spaces” and immersive production. Temper is a production from LED Presents, the San Diego electronic promoter that does year-round events throughout the city in spaces including Gallagher Square, EQ and Quartyard.

Beyond its flagship festivals, LED Presents continues to deliver a year-round calendar of electronic music events. Upcoming shows include Whethan, Nitefreak, Borgore, Boogie T and Bijou, all in August, Distant Matter, Chase & Status, Linska and Mochakk in September, Indo Warehouse, Know Good and Gorillat, Murda Beatz, EAZYBAKED and Jai Wolf in October, Dennett, Crankdat and Max Styler in November and the year closing out with Temper Festival on the day before New Year’s Eve.

A presale for Temper tickets starts on sale Aug. 10 at 12 p.m. with a general on sale beginning Aug. 11th at noon PT.
